senses.definition: n.[m.] possession (? so RV), perhaps better place of possession, place possessed by; only cstr. מִמְשַׁק חָרוּל Zp 2:9 a place possessed by chickpeas (> AV breeding of nettles), 𝔊 Δαμασκος. Word very dubious (We GASm); text prob. corrupt; SchwallyZAW x. 1890, 188 conj. meaning place of growth; Gr (so Now) proposes קִמּוֹשׂ, or קִמְּשׂנִים.
